<!-- Security problems: read SECURITY.md. Do not put private details in a public issue. -->

## What would you like to do?

Describe the problem, your suggested change and any alternatives.

## Versions and setup

- Console firmware (exact version, or not applicable):
- App name and exact version/build:
- PC operating system and Setup version, if relevant:
- Controller model and USB/Bluetooth connection, if relevant:

## Steps or example

Give an example of when this would help. No reproduction is required for a new idea.

## Logs and screenshots

Requested logs, if relevant and available: `/data/omni/native/crash.log`, `boot.log` from the installed build’s documented log location, and `/data/hub/logs/<app>/` (replace `<app>` with the affected app ID). If a file is absent or its location is unknown, say so; do not create an empty log.

Attach only a reviewed, redacted copy or explain why logs are unavailable/not relevant. Remove account names, local IP/Bluetooth addresses, personal paths, passwords, tokens, cookies and private links. Include the time of the problem. Do not upload whole console folders or original private logs.
